# ClearCut AI

> Free, 100% private, browser-native AI background remover and precision edge studio. Remove image backgrounds in full HD with zero server uploads, zero signup, and instant transparent PNG, WebP, or bulk ZIP exports.

Canonical URL: https://bg-remover-orpin-chi.vercel.app/
Sitemap: https://bg-remover-orpin-chi.vercel.app/sitemap.xml
Full Documentation: https://bg-remover-orpin-chi.vercel.app/llms-full.txt

## Core Facts
- **Price:** $0 (100% free, unlimited full-resolution downloads, no credits or watermarks)
- **Account Required:** None (no signup, no login)
- **Privacy Architecture:** On-device WebAssembly & neural client processing (zero image uploads in default/local modes)
- **Supported Inputs:** JPG, JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF (up to 15 MB per file; drag-and-drop, file picker, or Ctrl+V clipboard paste)
- **Supported Exports:** Transparent 32-bit PNG, JPG, WebP, Copy PNG to Clipboard, Mobile QR transfer link, and Batch ZIP archive (up to 10 images per batch)
- **Built-in Editing Tools:** Split Comparison Slider, Erase & Restore Brush Edge Refiner, Solid/Gradient/Scene/Blur/Custom Background Replacement, Realistic Drop Shadows, Canvas Crop & Aspect Ratio presets, AI Picture Enhancer, Global Undo/Redo

## Workflow Pages
- [AI Background Remover (Main Studio)](https://bg-remover-orpin-chi.vercel.app/): All-in-one free HD browser background remover with zero signup.
- [Offline Private Background Remover](https://bg-remover-orpin-chi.vercel.app/private-background-remover): 100% client-side in-browser privacy mode with zero server uploads.
- [E-Commerce Product Cutout Editor](https://bg-remover-orpin-chi.vercel.app/ecommerce-product-cutout): Pure white (#FFFFFF) Amazon, Shopify & Etsy product photo maker with drop shadows.
- [Portrait, Hair & Fur Edge Studio](https://bg-remover-orpin-chi.vercel.app/portrait-edge-studio): Fine hair, pet fur, and glass cutout matting with manual Erase & Restore brushes.
- [YouTube Thumbnail Cutout Maker](https://bg-remover-orpin-chi.vercel.app/youtube-thumbnail-cutout): Clipboard Ctrl+V screenshot paste, AI color boost, and 16:9 / 9:16 exports.
- [Passport & ID Background Remover](https://bg-remover-orpin-chi.vercel.app/passport-photo-background-remover): Offline white (#FFFFFF) and official blue passport, visa, and ID background changer.
- [Transparent Logo & Signature Maker](https://bg-remover-orpin-chi.vercel.app/logo-transparent-background-maker): Strip solid white or boxy backgrounds from logos, stamps, and signatures into crisp alpha PNGs.
- [Car Dealership Background Remover](https://bg-remover-orpin-chi.vercel.app/car-dealership-background-remover): Isolate vehicles cleanly while preserving metallic paint reflections, wheels, and tinted glass.
- [Batch ZIP Background Remover](https://bg-remover-orpin-chi.vercel.app/batch-background-remover): Process up to 10 images at once in-browser and export all HD PNG cutouts as one ZIP file.
- [Free remove.bg Alternative](https://bg-remover-orpin-chi.vercel.app/alternatives/remove-bg-alternative): Unlimited full-HD exports with zero per-image credit paywalls.

## Interactive Agent Quick-Start (DOM & URL Actions)
- **Open Batch Queue Directly:** Append `?tab=batch` (e.g., `https://bg-remover-orpin-chi.vercel.app/?tab=batch`) or click `#tab-batch-queue`
- **Auto-Run Sample Image:** Append `?sample=sample-portrait` (also `sample-product`, `sample-pet`, `sample-car`, `sample-shoes`, `sample-graphic`)
- **Upload File Input:** `#file-upload-input` (`<input type="file">`) or click `#dropzone-container`
- **Export / Download:** `#btn-download-image`, `#btn-copy-clipboard`, `#btn-qr-mobile-download`
- **WebMCP:** Registers structured tools on `navigator.modelContext` when supported by the browser agent runtime.
